request.text: At 6:30, check the weather in Pine Ridge before I drive over the mountain pass, and tell me whether rain or snow is expected. Don't assume the pass is open.

responsibilities.outcome: At 6:30, obtain the current forecast for Pine Ridge and report whether rain or snow is expected before the user's mountain-pass drive without inferring road status.

new_goals.description: Check Pine Ridge weather at 6:30 and report expected rain or snow before the user's mountain-pass drive.
new_goals.source_text: At 6:30, check the weather in Pine Ridge before I drive over the mountain pass, and tell me whether rain or snow is expected. Don't assume the pass is open.
success_criteria: Obtain weather Evidence before reporting expected rain or snow.
Keep weather findings separate from whether the pass is open or safe to drive.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The admitted Responsibility forms one time-gated weather-information Goal for a planned drive.

semantic_facts: The due time authorizes one chromie.weather.lookup for Pine Ridge; it does not itself supply a forecast result.
Any later report about rain or snow must be grounded in returned weather Evidence, and weather data must not be presented as proof that the mountain pass is open or safe.
forbidden_claims: Before lookup Evidence exists, the assistant asserts that rain or snow is or is not expected.
The assistant claims the mountain pass is open, closed, or safe based only on the due time or a weather forecast.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due lookup is collapsed into an unsupported forecast result instead of producing scoped information Work.
Weather authority expands into unsupported road-access or driving-safety authority.
